# dsh-pnpm-manager
Control whether the **pnpm** used by **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** goes through a proxy — and inspect /
switch its registry and store — from either DSH's settings page or a standalone CLI.
## Install
Use the bundled `dsh` CLI. Replace `<profile>` with your profile name (`desktop` for the app, `web`
sh` CLI. Replace `<profile>` with your profile name (`desktop` for the app, `web` for `dsh web`, …).
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Notes:
- The **desktop profile is locked by the running app** — close DeepSeek Harness before a CLI

install, or install from the app's Plugins panel.
- The git source works for a private repo too when

your git credentials are set; a public repo needs no auth.
- The npm command requires the package t
o be published (`npm publish`) first.
## Why
Node and pnpm do **not** use the Windows system proxy, so pnpm connects to `registry.npmjs.org` and
GitHub directly. Behind a firewall that is slow or fails with `ECONNRESET`. Pointing pnpm at a local
proxy (e.g. Clash on `127.0.0.1:7897`) makes dependency resolution several times faster — but if th
e proxy is down, installs fail. This tool makes that switch one click (or one command) away.
## What it touches
Only the `proxy`, `https-proxy` and `registry` lines of `~/.npmrc`. Every other setting is preserved
. A backup (`*.bak-<timestamp>`) is written only when the content actually changes.
## As a DSH plugin
`package.json` declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, and `cordis.patch.yml` inserts one host row. The row's `
Config` (schemastery) is rendered by DSH as the plugin's settings form:
| field | values | meaning |
| `mode` | `on` / `off` / `auto` | force proxy on / force direct / enable only when the proxy port i

s reachable |
| `proxyUrl` | URL | proxy address (default `http://127.0.0.1:7897`) |
| `noProxy` | h

osts (comma-separated) | hosts that bypass the proxy (`noproxy`; only while the proxy is on) |
| `st
rictSsl` | `true` / `false` | strict TLS verification; disable it for SSL-intercepting proxies (e.g.

Clash) → `strict-ssl=false` |
| `registry` | `keep` / `npmjs` / `npmmirror` | leave registry alone
/ official source / China mirror |
Editing the form rewrites `~/.npmrc` immediately (the loader re-applies the row).
> **Status:** verified in live DSH (isolated web profile **and** the desktop app): the host routes r
eturn live data; the card renders on the plugin's page **and** as a **pnpm 代理** tab under **Settings
→ Built-in plugins**, showing the mode status plus **开 / 关 / 自动 / 测试**. Host routes are also unit-t
lt-in plugins**, showing the mode status plus **开 / 关 / 自动 / 测试**. Host routes are also unit-tested.
### Client card (optional)
`lib/client.js` registers an editable form — mode, proxy URL, registry, no-proxy hosts, and strict-T
LS — with a **save confirmation** (edit → 保存 → 确认保存) and a **测试连接** button, into both the plugin's p
age (`plugins.bundle.config` / family seat) and a **Settings → Built-in plugins** tab (`settings.plu
gins.tab`). Registration is guarded and waits for the seat to be declared, so an unavailable seat ne
ver breaks the Web boot.
